Add a function total_value(items) to inventory.py that returns the sum of price times qty over all items.

Odd that only one line shows that "10|" prefix instead of every line having inline numbering -- I should grep the raw file to check if that's actually part of the file content or just leaked metadata.
The `10|` prefix was display metadata, not file content. Adding the function:

python3 -c "
import inventory as i
items=[i.make_item('a',2.5,4), i.make_item('b',3,0), i.make_item('c',1,7)]
print(i.total_value(items), i.total_value([]))"
